details:
- CVE-2026-97034: cmd/go - reject GCC spec files (specs, *.spec) in -L,
  -isysroot and -Wl,-syslibroot directories, and in the working and package
  directories when -fopenmp, -fopenacc or -fsanitize with -static or
  -static-lib* is passed, and reject -fsanitize= values starting with @ or -,
  preventing an untrusted spec file from running code at build time
- CVE-2026-97038: cmd/go - check .syso files, direct linker inputs and
  libraries in -L directories for GNU ld implicit linker scripts, COFF
  .drectve directives, Mach-O LC_LINKER_OPTION commands and LTO IR sections,
  and disallow -l:<file> and :, = or path separators in -l names, preventing
  code execution at link time
- CVE-2026-97039: cmd/go - remove --with-path= and --personality= from the
  pkg-config flag allowlist, disallow a leading = or $ in --define-variable=
  values, reject .pc files and paths as pkg-config package names, and check
  CGO_CPPFLAGS for flags not compatible with internal linking
- CVE-2026-97040: cmd/go, cmd/link - reject .syso files that are Go objects
  or have an unrecognized format, preventing unchecked cgo directives from
  being injected through them, and keep the .syso suffix when long archive
  member names are truncated
- CVE-2026-97043: cmd/go, cmd/compile - unquote //go:cgo_ldflag,
  //go:cgo_dynamic_linker and //go:cgo_import_dynamic strings with
  strconv.Unquote and handle escaped quotes in pragma fields, so quoted
  linker flags can no longer bypass checkLinkerFlags, and bound the cgo
  LDFLAGS removal loop to prevent an out-of-range panic
